## Empower Community Care Welcomes JP Guilbault as New CEO
...
In a significant leadership transition, Empower Community Care has appointed JP Guilbault as its new Chief Executive Officer. This announcement marks a pivotal moment for Empower, a leading organization in the behavioral health sector, renowned for its evidence-based programs and technology solutions that enhance outcomes for diverse populations, including youth and families. This strategic move comes after a decade of substantial achievement under former CEO and co-founder Josh Glade, who will continue his involvement with the organization as a board member. Guilbault's appointment is set against a backdrop of unprecedented growth and a rising demand for the gold-standard behavioral health solutions provided by Empower, which now supports practitioners across all 50 states in the U.S. and over 35 countries worldwide. Guilbault, recognized for his strong commitment to social impact and community support, will lead the organization's daily operations while focusing on its mission and core values. He brings a wealth of experience from previous roles, including his latest position as CEO of Navigate360, where he spearheaded initiatives enhancing safety in K-12 schools. His diverse background also includes leadership roles in organizations such as Community Brands and YourMembership, where he engaged with over 100,000 associations and nonprofits. In a statement, Glade expressed confidence in Guilbault's ability to steer the organization toward new heights. “JP stood out for his experience in scaling mission-driven organizations,” he stated, noting Guilbault's high regard for practitioners and families served by Empower. Glade, who significantly shaped Empower's trajectory over the past ten years, believes Guilbault is well-equipped to sustain the organization's positive impact on communities. Guilbault echoed similar sentiments during his appointment announcement, emphasizing his respect for the foundations laid by Glade and the team. “My role will be to honor that foundation while expanding our reach to support more families and communities than ever before,” he shared. His vision for Empower includes a steadfast commitment to maintaining the rigor and quality of clinical models while advancing the organization’s mission to improve welfare and deliver real outcomes for families. With Guilbault steering the ship, Empower Community Care is poised for a new chapter that promises not just growth but also a reinforced dedication to community-driven care. In addition to enhancing its services and technologies, the organization aims to innovate strategies that connect families with the support they need early, thereby fostering improvement in societal health outcomes. Empower Community Care has established itself as a trusted partner for public systems and community organizations, leveraging its expertise to deliver effective, evidence-based solutions. The organization currently supports more than 2,000 agencies and has been instrumental in strengthening services for over 3 million families globally. With a network of more than 23,000 trained professionals, Empower is committed to sustaining and expanding its efforts in the behavioral health arena. As Guilbault embarks on this new journey, Empower Community Care remains focused on its core mission: to offer high-quality, evidence-based programs that effect meaningful change and improve lives worldwide. The future looks bright for Empower under Guilbault’s leadership, promising to extend its impact even further—a goal echoed by both Guilbault and Glade, who continue to share a vision of supporting communities through compassionate and dedicated service. To learn more about Empower Community Care and its initiatives, visit EmpowerCommunityCare.com.

highlights:
After 10 years as CEO and helping Empower Community Care grow 20x, I'm stepping down today. Jean-Paul (JP) Guilbault is taking over, and I'm genuinely excited about what he and the team will do… | Josh Glade | 26 comments
...
After 10 years as CEO and helping Empower Community Care grow 20x, I'm stepping down today. Jean-Paul (JP) Guilbault is taking over, and I'm genuinely excited about what he and the team will do next. I'll remain on Empower's board and look forward to supporting our mission. A decade ago, Logan Greenspan and I set out with an unreasonable goal: help proven programs reach more youth and families. We started in a run-down little office with a visibly pitched floor. We used orange Home Depot buckets as trash cans because the real ones felt too expensive. The buckets got the job done. Today, Empower operates in every US state and 35+ countries. Programs across our organization have served more than three million families. That’s pretty cool. I'm proud of what our team has accomplished and the impact we've had together. A strong institution has to become larger than its founders. That is why this transition matters. JP has spent his career leading technology and mission-driven organizations at scale. He leads from values, not just a playbook, and has my full confidence. I have a ton of respect for the NexPhase Capital, LP team and believe they are the right owner for Empower. They understand the complexity of our work, share our commitment to evidence-based care, and bring deep experience in healthcare and technology. I'm also grateful to the investors who backed Empower at earlier stages including Northlane Capital Partners, Search Fund Partners, Relay Investments, Graue Mill Partners, Anacapa Partners, Bill & Mark Egan, Red Forest Capital, Endurance Search Partners, M2O, Inc. and others who supported us along the way. My kids are still young. I want to be more present for them and my wife. There isn't a grand next act mapped out. That's the point. To everyone who helped turn an unreasonable goal into something real: thank you. Keep the fire burning.
